head_turnaround: Using the attached character design (the model sheet and the high-resolution front drawing are the same character: the crab-themed idol girl with orange hair, two box-shaped buns, an ahoge, a yellow star hair clip and a small crab clip, amber eyes with slit pupils), draw a clean professional anime model sheet of HER HEAD ONLY (head, neck and top of the shoulders), in exactly the same art style, line weight and flat cel colouring as the attached sheet. Four views side by side in one row, all at exactly the same scale and eye height, on a plain flat light grey background: (1) front view, (2) three-quarter view turned to the viewer's left, (3) true side profile facing the viewer's left, (4) back view. Neutral relaxed expression with the same gentle closed-mouth smile as the front of the sheet. Draw the profile with a clearly readable anime profile: the eye set back behind the brow and the small pointed nose, the lips, and the rounded chin and jaw line going back to the neck. Keep the hair and accessories identical to the design. No text, no extra poses, no shadows on the background.
head_construction: Using the attached character design (same character as the model sheet: the crab-themed idol girl), draw a clean anime character CONSTRUCTION SHEET of her head WITHOUT HAIR (a bald head, showing the real skull and face shape underneath the hair), in the same art style and line weight. Two views side by side at exactly the same scale and eye height: (1) front view, (2) true side profile facing the viewer's left. Include her ears. Draw thin straight horizontal guide lines across both views at: the top of the skull, the brow, the eye line, the bottom of the nose, the mouth, the chin. In the profile, show clearly how far the eye sits back behind the brow-nose line, the small pointed nose, the lips and the chin, and the jaw line going back to the ear and neck. Plain flat light grey background, flat skin colour with minimal shading, no text.
garment_breakdown: Using the attached character design (the crab-themed idol girl's outfit on the model sheet), draw a clean GARMENT BREAKDOWN sheet of her outfit, like a costume designer's flat-lay: every separate piece of the outfit drawn apart from the others and from the body, arranged neatly on a plain white background, front view of each piece (and a back view for pieces that differ at the back). hair_breakdown: Using the attached character design (the crab-themed idol girl with voluminous wavy orange hair, two box-shaped buns and an ahoge), draw a HAIR BREAKDOWN sheet for a 3D modeller: her head in three views side by side at the same scale (front, true side profile facing the viewer's left, back), where the hair is divided into its separate locks and layers and EACH lock or layer is filled with its own distinct flat colour (like a colour-coded segmentation map), keeping the design's hair shape exactly. Use one colour family per layer group: the bangs/fringe locks, the side locks framing the face, the upper back layer, the lower back layer, the two buns, the ahoge, and loose flyaway strands, with each individual lock in that group a slightly different shade of the family so locks are separable. Face and skin in plain pale grey, accessories in plain white. Add a small legend listing each colour family's layer name. Plain white background, clean outlines.
